{{Quote|I can sneak you some of this ore that we are mining. Now before you get all mad about just getting ore let me tell you that this is the stuff that the Mandalores use in their armor.|[[Japer Witter]]|<ref name="SWG:JW">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=conversation|Japer Witter|Endor}}</ref>}}
[[File:Alum_Minerals.jpg|200px|thumb|A case of alum minerals]]
'''Alum''' was a metallic mineral [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. It was a double [[sulfate]] composed of a trivalent metal, [[Aluminium/Legends|aluminium]], and a univalent metal, [[potassium]] or [[Sodium/Legends|sodium]], used as either a clarifying agent or a hardening agent. Overexposure to fumes could lead to [[alum mineral sickness]], a common affliction of alum [[Mining/Legends|miners]] such as [[Haldo]]. Alum was a common material in the production of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]],<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> though the incredibly resilient properties of [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] made it the preferred choice for [[Armor/Legends|armor]] crafting among [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]].<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], members of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]<ref name="Galaxies" />—a radical and violent Mandalorian splinter group<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> led by a [[Unidentified Death Watch Overlord|Death Watch Overlord]]—excavated a vast network of alum mines located beneath their [[Death Watch bunker|bunker]] on the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Some [[Time/Legends|time]] around [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] defeated the contingent of [[Death/Legends|Death]] Watch [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] at the base, and went on to use the group's alum supply to manufacture Mandalorian armor for themselves.<ref name="Galaxies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alum first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' expansion, ''An Empire Divided''.
